title.en: Sakana AI releases Fugu Max and Fugu Ultra v2
title.zhHans: Sakana AI 发布 Fugu Max 与 Fugu Ultra v2

searchSummary.en: Sakana AI released Fugu Max and Fugu Ultra v2 as OpenAI-compatible API products built around learned orchestration of open and specialized models.
searchSummary.zhHans: Sakana AI 发布 Fugu Max 与 Fugu Ultra v2，将其作为基于开放模型和专业模型学习式编排的 OpenAI 兼容 API 产品。

summary.en: On September 11, Sakana AI released Fugu Max and Fugu Ultra v2 through an OpenAI-compatible API. Sakana describes them as one orchestration architecture optimized for cost-performance and peak capability, routing tasks across pools of open and specialized models rather than relying on a single monolithic model. OpenRouter lists both variants with September 11 availability, while independent commentary notes that performance comparisons remain largely tied to Sakana's own evaluations.
summary.zhHans: 9 月 11 日，Sakana AI 通过 OpenAI 兼容 API 发布 Fugu Max 和 Fugu Ultra v2。Sakana 将两者描述为同一编排架构的不同优化版本，分别面向成本性能和峰值能力；系统在开放模型和专业模型池之间路由任务，而不是依赖单一巨型模型。OpenRouter 列出了两款产品的 9 月 11 日可用性，独立评论则指出性能比较目前主要依赖 Sakana 自身评测。

narrative.en: Fugu treats orchestration as the product boundary: the API exposes a model-like interface while the system selects and coordinates multiple underlying models. Sakana reports that Fugu Max reaches favorable cost-performance positions and that Fugu Ultra v2 performs strongly on selected agentic benchmarks without Fable 5, Fable 5.1, or GPT-6 Astra in its pool. OpenRouter confirms availability and pricing, and Pondero describes the architecture and repeats the benchmark results. The evidence supports a released orchestration product, but not a general independent finding that it outperforms closed models across tasks.
narrative.zhHans: Fugu 将编排作为产品边界：API 对外呈现类似模型的接口，系统则选择并协调多个底层模型。Sakana 称 Fugu Max 在成本性能上处于有利位置，Fugu Ultra v2 在特定智能体基准上表现突出，且模型池不包含 Fable 5、Fable 5.1 或 GPT-6 Astra。OpenRouter 确认了可用性和价格，Pondero 描述了系统架构并复述基准结果。现有证据足以支持“编排产品已发布”，但不足以独立证明其在各类任务上普遍优于闭源模型。

description.en: Packages learned routing and multi-model coordination as a model-like API, offering a released path to combine open and specialized models for complex work.
description.zhHans: 将学习式路由和多模型协作打包为类似模型的 API，为复杂工作提供组合开放模型与专业模型的已发布路径。

description.en: Offers OpenAI-compatible access to a coordinated model pool, reducing the integration cost of switching among underlying models in an application.
description.zhHans: 通过 OpenAI 兼容接口提供协调模型池，降低应用在底层模型之间切换的集成成本。

text.en: Sakana AI released Fugu Max and Fugu Ultra v2 on September 11 and made them available through an OpenAI-compatible API.
text.zhHans: Sakana AI 于 9 月 11 日发布 Fugu Max 和 Fugu Ultra v2，并通过 OpenAI 兼容 API 提供使用。

text.en: Sakana describes Fugu Max as cost-performance optimized and Fugu Ultra v2 as quality optimized, with both variants coordinating pools of open and specialized models.
text.zhHans: Sakana 将 Fugu Max 描述为面向成本性能优化、将 Fugu Ultra v2 描述为面向质量优化；两款产品都协调开放模型和专业模型池。

text.en: Sakana's benchmark and frontier-comparison claims are not broad independent replications; OpenRouter verifies marketplace availability and pricing rather than performance.
text.zhHans: Sakana 的基准和前沿比较主张尚未得到广泛独立复现；OpenRouter 验证的是市场可用性和价格，而非性能。

editorial.reviewNotes: Provisional L2 orchestration-product node. Availability is confirmed; performance and frontier comparisons remain attributed or limited to available commentary.
